concerns.text: FR‑002 (link corrosion potential measurements to alloy composition without fuzzy matching) is never referenced by any task; the pipeline lacks a dedicated step to perform this deterministic linking.
SC‑003 (statistical significance testing of feature‑importance scores) is not mentioned in any task description; while FR‑008 covers permutation testing, the success‑criterion itself is omitted.
SC‑005 (total execution‑time ≤ 6 h on GitHub Actions) has no associated task that records or asserts the overall pipeline runtime.
Constitution Principle I requires a pinned random‑seed configuration; no task creates or validates a seed‑config file (e.g., `config/seeds.yaml`).
